texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: I’m interviewing for a PM role. What should I do to prepare?
texts.text: Q: I’m interviewing for a PM role. What should I do to prepare?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: I’ve interviewed hundreds of PMs over the years. As an interviewer, you want to believe that no matter how long the candidate has spent preparing, you can see through it all to their true PM nature. But that’s just not true. Preparing gives you a big leg up, even if you spend just a few hours. A little prep helps you nail common questions, build frameworks for confronting unexpected questions, and gets your mind into the interviewing game (which is very different from doing the job itself).
